customer_segment.value: B2B: Fuel refiners, mining companies, battery and petrochemical manufacturers, and industrial water treatment operators

quotes.quote: As a leading producer with an extensive history and significant expertise in the production of sulfuric acid and sulfuric acid regeneration, we are also a premier provider of sulfur-related technologies and services and related derivative products. Through our regeneration services business, we provide end-to-end recycling of spent sulfuric acid for our refining customers’ production of alkylate, a critical fuel blending component necessary to meet more stringent fuel specifications and provide for higher fuel efficiency and lower emissions.

We provide specialty grade high-purity virgin sulfuric acid for a number of diverse and growing end uses. Among them are mining, particularly copper for electronics applications, production of electric vehicles and the ongoing expansion of data centers across the globe, and industrial applications including our customers’ production of nylon precursors, production of lead acid batteries for all types of vehicles, industrial and municipal water treatment, and refining and petrochemical processes.
